# Medium

Generated from [tokens.json](tokens.json) and [README.md](README.md) by the design-systems catalog tool. Do not edit this file: change the tokens through the package's builders, then run `make design-md` at the repository root.

It follows the DESIGN.md spec, version alpha. That format has no themes, no per-value provenance and only px, em and rem units, so this file holds the `light` theme alone with every alias resolved. [tokens.json](tokens.json) is the source of truth: it records where each value was read, holds the `dark` theme, and keeps the 14 tokens from these groups that DESIGN.md cannot hold (gradients, shadows, percentages, durations and other non-colour or non-px values).

## Overview

Good for: Editorial reading pages: white or #171717 page, gt-super display, sohne UI, source-serif-pro body in a 680px column, a #191919 pill that flips white in dark, and accent green #1a8917 / #6ab668.

Captured 2026-11-19, signed out (home, membership, about, blog, one public staff story, plans, the sign-in card and the email step at rest, and the help center are public; Continue, Select, OAuth, Create one and checkout were not pressed; the signed-in home, editor and settings were not entered). Themes: light, dark.

A token set and component reference for Medium's public signed-out surface. It was read on **2026-11-19** from medium.com in the T3 preview browser, signed out, at a measured **1440 x 900** (devicePixelRatio 2) and **390 x 844**. Captured: the marketing home, membership, about, the blog home, one public staff story, the plans page, the sign-in card including the email step at rest, and the help center. Nothing was submitted. Google, LinkedIn, Facebook, Apple, X, Continue, Create one, Select, and checkout were not pressed.

Medium is worth a capture because the marketing site declares a real token layer. `:root` sets about 77 `--color-*` custom properties as `light-dark()` pairs, and `html[data-color-scheme]` plus `prefers-color-scheme` pick a side. Display type is **gt-super**. UI type is **sohne**. Story body is **source-serif-pro** at 20px / 32px in a 680px column. The primary action is a near-black pill in light (`#191919`, radius 1386px) and a white pill in dark. Accent green is `#1a8917` in light and `#6ab668` in dark. **Boundary:** the signed-in home, the editor, settings, and checkout sit behind sign-in and were not entered.

## Typography

No composite type styles in tokens.json; the README text below names the faces and sizes.

### Fonts (from README.md)

| Family | Where | Licence |
|---|---|---|
| gt-super | Home, membership, about, plans, sign-in titles | Proprietary. Not committed. Tokens fall back to Georgia, Cambria, Times New Roman, Times, serif |
| sohne | Nav, buttons, plan names, story titles on the blog, sign-in rows | Proprietary. Not committed. Tokens fall back to Helvetica Neue, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif |
| source-serif-pro | Story body | Adobe Source Serif. Not embedded. Tokens fall back to Georgia, serif |
| medium-content-sans-serif-font | Footer links, billing labels, Welcome Offer | A system stack: -apple-system, system-ui, Segoe UI, Roboto, Helvetica Neue |
| GT Super Text | help.medium.com h1 | Proprietary. Not committed |
| Sohne | help.medium.com UI | Same family as sohne, named with a capital S on that host |

`document.fonts` also listed charter, fell, noe, and opendyslexic. None of those were the computed family of a measured element on these pages.

## Do's and Don'ts

- Do take values from [tokens.json](tokens.json) when you need another theme, a value's source, or a token this file leaves out.
- Do read [README.md](README.md) before relying on a value; it says what is known to be wrong.
- Don't read colours off the screenshots; they are 256-colour PNGs.
- Don't copy the product's logo, icons, illustrations or brand colours into something that ships. Borrow structure and proportions.
- Don't edit this file; it is regenerated from the tokens.

### What to distrust (from README.md)

The screenshots and crops are reconstructions. Positions and colours come from computed styles. The wordmark in those PNGs is the word "Medium" in Helvetica, not the SVG. The style guide uses Georgia for gt-super and Helvetica for sohne. Those families are proprietary and are not in the package.

The home hero at 1440 was measured in light (`120px`, line-height `100px`, letter-spacing `-6.6px`, colour `#000000`). The 390 hero was measured in dark (`80px` / `72px` / `-4.4px`, colour `#ffffff`). A 1440 dark hero size was not remeasured.

Focus on Get started was read in dark: `outline: rgb(153, 200, 255) auto 1px`. The email field, once focused and still empty, kept `border: 1px solid transparent` and `outline: none`. No error, disabled, or loading state was on the public pages.

Help center colours are a separate Zendesk layer (`--bg-base`, `--text-primary`) in oklch, converted with canvas `fillStyle`. They are not the medium.com `--color-*` tokens. `oklch(0.58 0 0)` on the search border converted to black in that canvas and is not tokenised.

### Do and don't (from README.md)

1. **Do paint the page from the token pair.** Light page is `#ffffff` and text is `#242424`. Dark page is `#171717` and text is `#e5e5e5`. See [home-light-default](screenshots/home-light-default.png).
2. **Do set the hero in gt-super.** The home hero is 120px, line-height 100px, letter-spacing -6.6px. See [hero-display-light-default](components/crops/hero-display-light-default.png).
3. **Do make the primary action a pill.** Get started is `#191919` on light and `#ffffff` on dark, radius 1386px, padding 8px 16px, height 38px. See [button-primary-light-default](components/crops/button-primary-light-default.png).
4. **Do keep story body in a 680px column.** source-serif-pro 20px / 32px, letter-spacing -0.06px. See [story-body-light-default](components/crops/story-body-light-default.png).
5. **Do use the green only as accent.** `#1a8917` light, `#6ab668` dark. It was not the fill of any measured marketing button.
6. **Don't treat the PNGs as live screenshots.** They were drawn from computed styles after the preview frame capture failed and headless Playwright hit Cloudflare.
7. **Don't style the signed-in app from this package.** The editor, library, and settings were not opened. See [signin-light-default](screenshots/signin-light-default.png).
8. **Don't submit from this package.** Continue, Select, and the OAuth rows were measured and not pressed.
